data.long_meaning: Zaraan is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'zar', meaning 'to shine'. In Hindu mythology, Zaraan is the name of a celestial being, or a deity associated with light, radiance, and wisdom. The name Zaraan carries the meaning “Radiant, Shining” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Zaraan usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, shining and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for one who embodies light and wisdom, and inspires enlightenment.
